title: Add flexible workflow modes and script rewrite channels
description: Support full-auto and semi-auto starts from any module, including direct pasted script workflows that skip video parsing. Add original-script passthrough plus A/B/C rewrite strengths, with full-auto defaulting to B and the user choice saved as a global preference.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a user pastes a script THEN they can skip video parsing and continue to storyboard, TTS, and draft generation; WHEN rewrite is selected THEN A, B, and C modes are available; WHEN full-auto runs THEN B is the default unless a global preference was changed; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:54
review_initial_requirements: Verify passthrough does not call the text model and rewrite templates are visible only in advanced mode.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm global rewrite preference persists for new tasks while existing generated task content is not silently rewritten.

title: Implement per-module API failover profiles
description: Upgrade API profile handling so each AI module has a primary profile and ordered backup profiles. Calls should retry according to module policy, switch to a backup endpoint on failure, continue on success, and pause with progress preserved when no usable backup remains.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN text, image, parsing, or AI director calls fail with retryable errors THEN the next configured backup profile is tried; WHEN all profiles fail THEN the task pauses with a visible reason; WHEN logs and exports are inspected THEN API keys are not exposed; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:203
review_initial_requirements: Verify profile order, retryable error classification, active fallback selection, and no-secret logging with unit tests.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm existing single active profile behavior migrates safely and image generation failures do not stop the whole queue by default.

title: Upgrade image generation parameters and per-shot asset controls
description: Add preset-first image generation parameters including 9:16, advanced controls, per-shot status, single image enlargement, regenerate, failed-shot补图, and queue stop/continue without full reruns.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN generating stickman images THEN 9:16 and other presets are available; WHEN a shot image fails or is unsatisfactory THEN the user can补图 or regenerate only that shot; WHEN an image thumbnail is clicked THEN it enlarges and can return to thumbnail state; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:113
review_initial_requirements: Verify queue state updates per shot and successful assets are not regenerated unless explicitly requested.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm material library updates in real time, file names preserve sequence order, and stop/continue does not lose saved assets.

title: Add manual external material labeling and placeholders
description: Implement task-level external material labels for tool demos, real drama clips, emotional boost clips, hooks, conversion clips, and proof clips. AI may arrange only user-labeled material, and must create clear placeholders when matching material is missing.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN external material is imported THEN users can label its intended use; WHEN AI draft planning needs material and no matching asset exists THEN a placeholder clip is created instead of guessing; WHEN materials are displayed THEN labels remain editable and visible in the task asset library; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:127
review_initial_requirements: Verify labels are manual-first and AI does not infer destructive or unsupported usage from file names alone.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm placeholders flow into the timeline/draft plan and do not block the rest of the task.

title: Integrate local TTS voice presets and generation path
description: Turn TTS into a local path configured module with default path D:\Index-TTS2_ZZDH, global default voice, task-level temporary voice, common voice presets, and a clear unavailable state. Do not bundle TTS models, checkpoints, venv, or Index-TTS2 into the installer.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN TTS settings open THEN default local path and common voice presets are available; WHEN a task selects a voice THEN it can override the global default for that task; WHEN local TTS is unavailable THEN the task pauses only the TTS step and earlier assets remain usable; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:140
review_initial_requirements: Verify TTS settings export is sanitized and package checks prove no local TTS model directory is bundled.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm manual audio fallback remains available and TTS failure does not erase script, storyboard, or images.

title: Generate subtitle cues and unified timeline from TTS or fallback timing
description: Create subtitle cue generation that prefers TTS timestamps and falls back to sentence-length timing. Assemble images, labeled external assets, voice audio, subtitles, BGM or SFX into a unified timeline that remains editable.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN TTS returns timestamps THEN subtitle cue timing uses them; WHEN timestamps are absent THEN fallback cue timing is generated from sentence length and target speech rate; WHEN timeline is assembled THEN visual, voice, subtitle, and optional audio tracks are ordered by storyboard sequence; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:156
review_initial_requirements: Verify timing math, cue ordering, fallback behavior, and asset references with automated tests.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm timeline regeneration preserves locked or manually selected assets unless the user explicitly replaces them.

title: Generate editable Jianying drafts with AI director locks
description: Implement the Edit Draft module so she火 outputs editable Jianying drafts and task material packages rather than default MP4. The AI director must produce a structured edit plan with transitions, zoom, emphasis subtitles, placeholders, and shot/track locks.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a draft is generated THEN a new Jianying draft directory is created with task ID and timestamp and old drafts are not overwritten; WHEN shots or clips are locked THEN the AI director does not alter them; WHEN material is missing THEN the draft includes placeholders for manual replacement; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:163
review_initial_requirements: Verify draft generation is editable in Jianying and does not rely on fragile auto-export.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm overwrite, deletion, publishing, and modification of detected manual edits require user confirmation.

title: Implement resumable task state and recovery policy
description: Persist per-step task status and recovery metadata for source, script, storyboard, images, TTS, subtitles, timeline, and draft generation. On app restart, automatically continue safe production steps and require confirmation only for publish, upload, deletion, overwrite, or manually edited draft replacement.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the app restarts with incomplete work THEN safe steps can resume from the failed item without redoing successful assets; WHEN no backup API or local TTS is available THEN the task pauses with reason; WHEN destructive or publish-like actions are pending THEN user confirmation is required; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:222
review_initial_requirements: Verify each step records waiting, running, success, failed, skipped, or needs-manual state.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm successful images, audio, subtitles, and draft assets are not regenerated during recovery unless explicitly requested.

acceptance_criteria: WHEN validation completes THEN tests, typecheck, lint, build, and desktop packaging pass or limitations are recorded; WHEN the packaged app is inspected THEN Index-TTS2, checkpoints, venv, and model files are absent; WHEN handoff is complete THEN a user manual exists and explains the phase 2 workflow without cluttering the app UI; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-18-ta-huo-video-factory-phase2-design.md:262
review_initial_requirements: Verify final validation uses the packaged or installed app for the core workflow where practical.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm current activation behavior remains intact and one-machine activation is documented as later-stage work, not accidentally half-implemented.
